review:
Danny Dollar is the second half of Hacksaw's Cash Kings, following Donny Dough. It's a 5x5 payline slot where Danny symbols expand upward into wild Dollar-Reels, nudges shift symbols into place, and a progressive global multiplier climbs through the bonus rounds.

Hacksaw describes it as medium-high volatility, a step softer than many of its titles, and caps it at 12,500x in every mode. The game-show presentation and stage curtains match Donny Dough well, and the two later teamed up in Donny and Danny. A good one to try if you liked the LootLines games but want more frequent wild action.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
